title: Habits That Cost Offers: Fix Weak Patterns

scenes.line1: Are your habits costing job offers?
scenes.say: Are your habits costing you job offers? Which ones hurt most in interviews?

scenes.label: We
scenes.sub: Saying 'we' hides your impact. Use 'I' for your part.
scenes.say: Saying 'we' hides your impact. Switch to 'I' and highlight what you did.
Add numbers, explain tools, focus on fixes, and keep answers concise. These simple changes make you look strong.

scenes.question: How did you handle a team disagreement?
scenes.wrong: I blamed the other team for mistakes.
scenes.right: I gathered data, stayed calm, focused on the fix, and kept the relationship strong.
scenes.say: If asked about a disagreement, never blame. Show you solved the issue and kept things positive.
